name: material-theme
description: Generate light and dark Material color themes, convert colors, and export platform-specific theme code from a brand color.

interface.shortDescription: Generate cross-platform themes from a brand color.
interface.longDescription: Generate and apply cross-platform light and dark themes from a brand color. Installing the plugin also registers its local MCP server. The prebuilt server includes its runtime dependencies and starts with Node.js 22+ without npm installation, compilation, or an API key.
defaultPrompt: Generate a light and dark theme from #6750A4 for this project's existing styling system.
Convert this brand color and show its complementary, analogous, and triadic colors.
